name: Stoley's Bottle
summary: Stoley’s Bottle holds Steamwheedle bilge rum, sent to Booty Bay for Sea Wolf MacKinley. Its harsh taste may settle a debt between MacKinley and Stoley.

sections.title: A Bitter Bottle
sections.body: In Booty Bay, Sea Wolf MacKinley receives a bottle of Steamwheedle bilge rum from Stoley. MacKinley expects the drink to put his doubts about Booty Bay booze to rest. One taste proves the rum is terrible. It is thick as gravel and burns like lava, just as Stoley promised.

faq.answer: Stoley’s Bottle contains Steamwheedle bilge rum.
Sea Wolf MacKinley in Booty Bay is meant to receive Stoley’s Bottle.

faq.q: Why does MacKinley want the bottle?
faq.answer: MacKinley wants to put his doubts about Booty Bay booze to rest by tasting Stoley’s Steamwheedle bilge rum.

faq.q: What does the rum taste like?
faq.answer: MacKinley finds the rum terrible, thick as gravel and burning like lava.

faq.q: Does the bottle settle Stoley’s debt?
faq.answer: After tasting the rum, MacKinley says Stoley can keep the money he owes. The drink is as harsh as Stoley promised.
